title: Modernization of Periodic Reporting and Issuer Disclosure for Public Companies
summary: The SEC proposes amendments to the periodic disclosure reports that public company issuers file, updating the contents of the registration statement and ongoing periodic filings. The proposal applies to issuers with securities registered under the federal securities laws.
full_text: The Securities and Exchange Commission proposes amendments to modernize the periodic disclosure reports that public company issuers file. The proposal updates the contents of the registration statement used to register an offering of securities and the ongoing periodic filings, such as the annual and quarterly disclosure reports, that issuers submit to investors. The requirements apply to issuers whose securities are registered under the federal securities laws and that report to the Commission.
